basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 20-year-old college student from Sydney, Australia. I'm majoring in computer science and love diving into the world of online games and trading communities. In my free time, you can catch me exploring new tech gadgets or browsing through online marketplaces like Depop. I usually hop online during the evenings, especially after 6 PM local time after classes. Currently, I'm single and enjoying the freedom to explore my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a college student majoring in computer science, I have a solid understanding of technology and online platforms. My interest in online trading comes from self-teaching and actively participating in trading games like Adopt Me on Roblox. I enjoy learning about new trading strategies and market values.
